Offline nftables and iptables runtime for x86-64 Debian 11+/Ubuntu 20.04+ hosts.
Source: https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/20261020T000000Z/dists/trixie/main/binary-amd64/Packages.xz
Binaries and libraries were extracted from Debian 13 amd64 packages without modification,
including glibc 2.41. bin/nft and bin/iptables are added wrapper scripts that start the
binaries through the bundled ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 with --library-path, so the host glibc is
not used. Unused iconv modules (usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/gconv) and manual pages are omitted.
The archive preserves /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright for each package.
Runtime archive SHA-256: 7b3e499cd663f4ac77c14a0f6806ee44e3455d35cbca134e65b666b9c6cbe033
Corresponding Debian source archive SHA-256: 99b4ef60318a9fc5d68168fee5259ae91576779bd759c103a2f5c8ac5c0fc30a
The offline package includes nft-sources-trixie.tar.gz with original source,
Debian packaging patches, and signed source descriptors. Exact source file
names, sizes, and SHA-256 values are pinned in source-manifest.json.
